entries.heading: (a) Rule of
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 20013.  (a) Rule of 
Construction.--In the case of a public health emergency, no 
authorization of appropriations in section 2014 of title 38, United 
States Code, may be construed as limiting amounts that may be 
appropriated for carrying out subchapter II of chapter 20 of such title.

    (b) Grants and Per Diem Payments.--In 
the case of a public health emergency, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs 
may waive any limits on--
            (1) grant amounts under sections 2011 and 2061 of title 38, 
        United States Code; and
            (2) rates for per diem payments under sections 2012 and 2061 
        of such title.

    (c) Participant Absence.--Notwithstanding 
Veterans Health Administration Handbook 1162.01(1), dated July 12, 2013, 
and amended June 30, 2014, and titled ``Grant and Per Diem (GPD) 
Program'', or any other provision of law, for the duration of a public 
health emergency, the Secretary--
            (1) shall waive any requirement 
        to discharge a veteran from the grant and per diem program of 
        the Veterans Health Administration after the veteran is absent 
        for 14 days; and
            (2) may continue to pay per diem to grant recipients and 
        eligible entities under the program for any additional days of 
        absence when a veteran has already been absent for more than 72 
        hours.
